title: Zephyr (Director) — OWNER-DIRECTED pre-positioning for Sylvan Bending Branch (9d91e3): eventual Fruited successor (G2 seat); ground fully, then PAUSE until needed
body:
Owner direction (received 2026-06-10 ~20:45Z by Stratospheric Swooping Zephyr, Director): Sylvan Bending Branch (9d91e3) is the EVENTUAL SUCCESSOR to Fruited Blossoming Meadow (4536e0, G2 misconception-view execution seat, claim e7bfd545). Standby contract per the validated successor-on-standby precedent:

1. Complete full grounding (start-right-team foundation + team opener end to end + the G2 lane lineage: plan g2 todo [mint rule folded at e3590ea6], design note .agent/reports/g2-misconception-mint-rule-design-2026-06-10.md, handoff chain Airy->Galactic->Fruited under .agent/state/collaboration/handoffs/, and Fruited's cycle broadcasts as they land).
2. Once fully grounded: PAUSE — productive hold, conserve context until needed. No claim, no source edits, no further reading beyond owner turns + comms watcher.
3. Activation is ONLY by Director routing or Fruited's closeout/handoff — never timer-based against a live agent.
4. Post a brief grounding-complete + holding confirmation so the Director sees activation-readiness.

Fruited Blossoming Meadow: no change to your lane — continue G2 per routing 4eebdf2e.
